## 21. Next step — V1.41 micro-scope

The next step must remain below the level of speculative cache architecture. The proposed
V1.41 scope is:

1. audit whether `ResolutionCache` should gain an explicit `get_or_build_for_graph()` API rather
   than relying on caller sequencing;
2. quantify duplicate builds under concurrent same-key misses;
3. decide, with measurements, whether single-flight is worth its synchronization cost;
4. test cache reuse across repeated scene/frame lifetimes without introducing global ownership;
5. audit explicit cache hand-off between renderer/frame boundaries;
6. test memory pressure using real `ResolvedComponent` sizes rather than entry count alone;
7. inspect whether immutable result objects can be safely shared across frame boundaries;
8. add a cache telemetry contract only if actual consumers require it;
9. re-check geometry/resolution cross-surface invalidation after any lifecycle change;
10. keep the COLOR boundary strictly unchanged unless a distinct real production consumer is
    independently proven.

No V1.41 implementation should begin by adding a global cache or a persistence layer without
first proving that one of those lifetimes is actually used by the runtime.
